name: Generac
legal_name: Generac Holdings Inc. (NYSE: GNRC); Generac Power Systems, Inc.; international arm Pramac (PR Industrial S.r.l.)
revenue: US$4.21 billion (2025); Q2 2026 net sales US$1.17 billion, C&I segment US$556 million (up 29 percent)
sector: Residential, commercial and industrial generators (diesel, gaseous, bi-fuel), transfer switches, MPS paralleling, BESS; large diesel data centre sets 1.75 to 3.25 MW on Baudouin M55 engines
positioning_text: Generac is a US residential and C&I generator maker that pivoted hard into data centres in 2025 to 2026: its SDMD1750 to SDMD3250 diesel sets (Baudouin Baudouin M55 and Baudouin M55 engines, Marathon DataMAX alternators, DSE G8601 controls, 50 degree C cooling) won a global supply agreement with a hyperscale operator covering the Middle East, and its data centre backlog reached about US$1.6 billion by July 2026. In the Gulf it operates through Pramac's PR Middle East FZE in Jebel Ali and through dealers listed on its international locator: Atlas Power Solutions (Dubai and Riyadh), Watan Altaqa for Equipment (Riyadh) and Al Mulla Power Solutions (Kuwait). Mid-range diesel sets (SD1000, SD1250) use Perkins 4008 and 4012 engines, and its own spark-ignited gas engines power the SG/MG range to 1,000 kW.

movements.headline: Generac Q1 2026: C&I sales up 28 percent on data centre demand; final-stage vendor approval with multiple hyperscalers
movements.summary: Net sales rose 12 percent to US$1.06 billion, C&I external sales rose about 28 percent to US$510 million, and Generac raised full-year guidance to mid-to-high teens growth with C&I in the mid-to-high 20s percent.

relevance.analysis: Confirms Generac is becoming a scale supplier of large data centre gensets. For Cummins Arabia this is a new name on hyperscaler approved vendor lists rather than an immediate local competitor.

movements.headline: Generac signs global supply agreement with a hyperscale data centre operator covering APAC, Europe, Middle East and Latin America
movements.summary: The unnamed hyperscaler qualified Generac after factory visits and performance reviews. Production is at Beaver Dam, Oshkosh and Sussex, Wisconsin. Generac cited its EPC Power collaboration and Enercon enclosure acquisition.

relevance.analysis: The Middle East is explicitly in scope, so Gulf hyperscale sites can be supplied from a global frame agreement without a local tender. Cummins Arabia should coordinate with Cummins Inc. global hyperscale account teams to defend Saudi and UAE campuses and make sure local service capability is part of the global pitch.

movements.headline: Generac SD3250 (3.25 MW, Baudouin Baudouin M55) wins Consulting-Specifying Engineer 2026 gold award; large diesel series 1.75 to 3.25 MW
movements.summary: The 3.25 MW unit is Generac's largest diesel set, part of a new large diesel series from 1.75 to 3.25 MW built for data centres, healthcare and infrastructure.

relevance.analysis: The series maps onto Cummins Arabia's C2000 to C3500 data centre band. Note the engine is Baudouin, so the product competes on Generac packaging and Baudouin lead time, not on a proprietary engine.

movements.headline: Generac buys Belvidere, Illinois plant to add large-megawatt genset packaging capacity from Q1 2027, after February 2026 Enercon acquisition
movements.summary: The facility adds over 100 jobs and follows the acquisition of Enercon Engineering (enclosures and switchgear) and expansions in Oshkosh, Beaver Dam and Sussex.

relevance.analysis: More US packaging capacity shortens Generac lead times for export orders in 2027. Cummins Arabia should expect Generac to quote competitive delivery on Gulf hyperscale sites from 2027.

movements.headline: Generac promotes Niccolo Borracchini to EVP International (Generac and Pramac outside US and Canada)
movements.summary: Borracchini, with Pramac since 2015 and SVP International since 2024, now leads EMEA, APAC and LATAM; Paolo Campinoti retired 2026-07-01 to an advisory role.

relevance.analysis: A Pramac-rooted leader running international suggests the Gulf will be served through the Pramac Dubai structure. Cummins Arabia should track whether PR Middle East FZE begins quoting large Generac data centre sets in UAE and KSA.

movements.headline: Generac Q2 2026: data centre backlog about US$1.6 billion, second hyperscale agreement secured, C&I up 29 percent
movements.summary: Net sales US$1.17 billion (up 11 percent); C&I US$556 million; nearly US$700 million committed for 2027 from the first hyperscale agreement and about US$1 billion of additional orders; full-year C&I growth guided to the low 30s percent.

relevance.analysis: Two hyperscale frame agreements in one quarter means Generac is now a standing option for hyperscaler standby fleets. Cummins Arabia's exposure is in Saudi and UAE hyperscale campuses awarded through global procurement.
